name: Hong Kong: unincorporated businesses

tests: Profits tax applies to profits arising in or derived from Hong Kong, whatever the residence

source.title: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Hong Kong, residence

prepayments.what: Final and first provisional tax instalment (date on the notice)

calendar.note: There is no VAT. The year of assessment runs 1 April to 31 March; the profits tax of a year is assessed the next year and paid in instalments in January and April (with provisional tax for the year after), so the reserve stays until 30 April two years after the year starts.

sources.title: IRD: A guide to profits tax for unincorporated businesses

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

presets.label: No VAT + profits tax reserve 15% (two-tier: 7.5% then 15%)

buckets.name: profits_tax
buckets.label: Profits tax (unincorporated: 7.5% on the first HK$2 million, 15% above)

items.name: mpf
items.label: MPF for the self-employed: 5%, from HKD 85,200 of income

notes: Only profits sourced in Hong Kong are taxed.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
